heading: Maggie Bittarelli
whatIsNow: (This is a now page, and if you have your own site, you should make one, too.)
lastUpdated: January 6, 2026, from the Greater Boston Area, MA

updates.heading: So cold
paragraphs: It takes a lot of work for me to stay warm in the dead of winter. I'm a firm believer in getting outside every day if possible but this time of year is a real struggle to stay true to that!

updates.heading: Party time
paragraphs: Biting off perhaps a bit more than I can chew, I'm helping to plan birthday festivities for a friend's son (the family could use an extra hand at the moment) and also working with a team to plan L's preschool's annual fundraising gala.

updates.heading: Reading Stephen King
paragraphs: I'm nearly finished with my first Stephen King book - Fairy Tale. It's been a very easy read, as long as it is. I love a good long story. This Autumn I read a final book in a trilogy that I'd had high hopes for but that had really let me down, and I'm feeling a bit heartbroken from it still. I needed something like this to restore some enjoyment in reading.
